steps.meaning: The Riverside corridor traffic study is finalized with peer-review sign-off.
steps.name: study_finalized

steps.meaning: External reviewer delivers peer-review sign-off to Santos.
steps.name: peer_review_signoff
steps.uncertainty: The reviewer committed to deliver by this time, but actual delivery may be delayed.

steps.meaning: Santos emails the finalized study to council members within an hour after receiving peer-review sign-off.
steps.name: santos_emails_study

steps.meaning: The email with the study is delivered to Reyes's inbox.
steps.name: email_delivered

steps.meaning: Reyes checks her email and notices the study.
steps.name: reyes_checks_email
steps.uncertainty: Reyes may not check email before the meeting if the study arrives late or she is busy.

steps.meaning: Reyes reads the finalized study in full.
steps.name: reyes_reads_study
steps.uncertainty: Reyes may not have time to read the full study before the meeting if it arrives late.
